mapper.sql: select e.employee_id, e.employee_code, e.employee_name, e.gender, e.birthday, e.id_card, e.phone, e.email, e.employee_type, e.dept_id, d.dept_name, e.position, e.entry_date, e.leave_date, e.status, e.education, e.major, e.school, e.work_years, e.marital_status, e.political_status, e.nation, e.native_place, e.address, e.emergency_contact, e.emergency_phone from hrs_employee e left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = e.dept_id
